description: This Java source file defines the RabbitMQClientActor class, an actor responsible for managing connections and communication with an AMQP 0.9.1 RabbitMQ server. It handles connection setup, queue declaration, consumer creation, message handling, and connection lifecycle management within an Akka actor system. The class collaborates with other internal components to facilitate messaging, error handling, and connection monitoring in a distributed system.

classes.name: RabbitMQClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class managing RabbitMQ connections, message consumers, and publisher channels, including connection lifecycle, error handling, and message processing.

classes.name: RabbitMQMessageConsumer
classes.description: A custom RabbitMQ consumer handling message delivery, consumer status updates, and connection-related events, updating source statuses accordingly.

classes.name: SendChannel
classes.description: A helper class used to send the Channel object to a specified recipient ActorRef.

classes.name: RmqConsumerChannelCreated
classes.description: A wrapper class representing a successfully created channel, implementing ClientConnected interface.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration for RabbitMQClientActor with connection and optional test factory.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates test configuration Props with custom connection factory factory.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Performs a test connection to RabbitMQ, establishing channels and reporting status.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Initiates connection to RabbitMQ server, creating necessary channels and actors.

methods.name: doDisconnectClient
methods.description: Handles disconnection logic, notifying self to update state.

methods.name: startConsumerActors
methods.description: Starts consumer actors for queues specified in the connection after channel creation.

methods.name: startConsumers
methods.description: Begins consuming messages from configured queues, creating consumer actors for each.

methods.name: ensureQueuesExist
methods.description: Verifies existence of queues; throws exception if any are missing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to RabbitMQ and creates publisher channels, handling reconnects and errors.

methods.name: cleanupResourcesForConnection
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including stops consumers, publisher, and connection actors.
